def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    species_map = {
        'adelie': 'Adelie', 'Adelie': 'Adelie',
        'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap', 'Chinstrap': 'Chinstrap',
        'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'Gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo',
    }
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().map(species_map).fillna(df['species'])
    # body_mass_g stored as text with commas -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # flipper_length_mm may be text; convert and invalidate out-of-range/negative values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Enforce body mass range
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in means.items()}
